form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. list-input-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Key
form:FormGroup.helpText: Parameter name that the selected value is given. Use it in queries and expressions as ${{key}, e.g. a key of user is used as ${{user}.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Parameter name, used in queries as ${{key}.

form:FormGroup.label: Values
form:FormGroup.helpText: Values offered in the list, one value per line. Ignored when Use Dictionary is ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Dictionary
form:FormGroup.helpText: Dictionary whose words are offered in the list when Use Dictionary is ticked. You need Use permission on the dictionary.
